## Summary

Kyle Matthew Calingasan is an Information Technology Specialist and Backend Developer based in Batangas and Taguig, Philippines. He graduated Cum Laude with a Bachelor of Science in Information Technology, major in Networking Technology, from Batangas State University TNEU - Lipa Campus. His technical interests and experience include backend systems, RESTful APIs, IoT, AI-driven applications, AWS, Java EE, Docker, Kubernetes, and Red Hat OpenShift.
